newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda Motor to sell lawnmowers in U.S. - paper.
newsitem.headline: Honda Motor to sell lawnmowers in U.S. - paper.

text.p: Honda Motor Co Ltd has tied up with Home Depot Inc to sell home-use lawnmowers in the United States, a Japanese business daily reported on Tuesday.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said Honda planned to spend 500 million yen to develop lawnmowers to be sold through Home Depot stores in the United States. The firms aimed to begin sales by the end of 1997, it said.
The price of the lawnmowers was expected to range from $300 to $400, about 50 percent cheaper than existing models, the paper said.
Honda currently sells about 110,000 business-use lawnmowers a year in the United States, the paper said.
